snippet.title: Hostile Lands - Story Trailer - 2D Top-Down Roguelite Shooter - GameMaker
snippet.description:
Hostile Lands - Story Trailer - 2D Top-Down Roguelite Shooter - GameMaker

Hostile Lands is a fast-paced, roguelite, bullet-hell shooter where your crash landing is taken personally by the locals. Blast through bloodthirsty bandits, murderous monsters, and hazardous pitfalls as you fight your way off a planet that hates you. But here's the catch: every successful escape just fuels the inhabitants RAGE against you. The bandits get angrier, the bullets fly thicker, and the traps get deadlier. How many of your crew can you save before the Hostility becomes too much?

Available Now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3075890/Hostile_Lands/

Original Music:
Thomas Stanford

📜 Full OST Playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL6TFhA6plrD4YWCEB_pnVj7LyvP0wWVN5
